series.name: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)
series.notes: Separate documented table in the same manual (section 8.2.2 'Battery error list'). The ID namespace jumps to 8xx/9xx here - these numbers NEVER collide with the inverter-side ID0xx rows, so they cannot be confused with SERIES 5. Battery-side rows also appear in the ESI 3-6K-S1 manual with the same numbers; kept separate per the one-series-per-table rule.

meaning.en: The battery's own heat-sink temperature sensor is above the warning threshold. A warning, not a shutdown - the battery is still usable.
meaning.ur: Battery ke apne heat-sink temperature sensor ki value warning threshold se upar hai. Ye sirf warning hai, shutdown nahi - battery abhi bhi chalti hai.

causes.en: Battery cabinet installed in direct sun or a poorly ventilated store room.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet direct sun mein ya kam ventilated store room mein lagi hai.

causes.en: High charge/discharge current pushing the battery's internal heat up.
causes.ur: Zyada charge/discharge current battery ki andar ki heat barha raha hai.

solutions.en: Check that the number of batteries configured on the LCD matches the number physically installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke LCD par configured batteries ki sankeya physically installed batteries ke barabar hai.

solutions.en: Install the battery in a cool, ventilated place out of direct sunlight and leave the recommended clearance.
solutions.ur: Battery ko thande, ventilated jagah direct sunlight se door lagayein aur recommended clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: If the configuration is already correct and the warning stays, contact technical support for a software upgrade as the manual says.
solutions.ur: Agar configuration pehle se theek hai phir bhi warning rahe to manual ke mutabiq technical support se software upgrade karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

meaning.en: The temperature inside the battery cabinet exceeded the ambient warning threshold. Manual action: make sure the battery is installed in a cool, well-ventilated place.
meaning.ur: Battery cabinet ke andar ka temperature ambient warning threshold se upar chala gaya. Manual ka action: battery thande, well-ventilated jagah lagi honi chahiye.

causes.en: Battery in a closed cupboard or against a hot wall with no airflow.
causes.ur: Battery band cupboard mein ya garm deewar se lagay, jahan koi airflow nahi.

causes.en: Very hot season with high ambient plus poor spacing between battery units.
causes.ur: Bahut garmi ka mausam, zyada ambient aur battery units ke darmiyan kam faasla.

solutions.en: Measure the ambient temperature inside the battery location with a thermometer and compare to the manual's limit.
solutions.ur: Battery ki jagah ka andar ka ambient temperature thermometer se measure karke manual ki limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Relocate or open up ventilation so air can move through and around the battery cabinet.
solutions.ur: Battery cabinet ko aise jagah shift karein ya ventilation kholein ke hawa aas paas chale.

solutions.en: Keep at least the manual's stated clearance between stacked battery modules.
solutions.ur: Stack kiye gaye battery modules ke darmiyan kam az kam manual ka bataya hua faasla rakhein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

title.ur: Battery charging prohibited - BMS ne charging rok di (ID813)

meaning.en: The BMS has blocked battery charging. The manual says this is normal if the battery is almost fully charged; only contact support if that is not the reason.
meaning.ur: BMS ne battery charging block kar di hai. Manual ke mutabiq agar battery poori tarah charge ho chuki hai to ye normal hai; sirf tab support se rabta karein jab woh wajah na ho.

causes.en: Battery already at or near full charge - BMS stops charging to avoid overcharge.
causes.ur: Battery poori tarah ya qareeb poori charge ho chuki hai - BMS overcharge se bachne ke liye charging rokta hai.

causes.en: Battery temperature outside the safe charging window.
causes.ur: Battery temperature safe charging window se bahar hai.

causes.en: Cell imbalance or a cell above its charge limit inside the pack.
causes.ur: Pack ke andar cell imbalance ya koi cell apni charge limit se upar.

solutions.en: Read the SOC on the LCD; if it is near 100% this is normal and needs no action.
solutions.ur: LCD par SOC padhein; agar wo 100% ke qareeb hai to ye normal hai aur koi action nahi chahiye.

solutions.en: If SOC is low, check battery temperature - the BMS blocks charging when it is too hot or too cold.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC kam hai to battery temperature check karein - BMS garm ya thand par charging rokta hai.

solutions.en: If SOC is low and temperature is normal, contact technical support rather than forcing charge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC kam hai aur temperature normal hai to charge force karne ke bajaye technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

title.ur: Battery discharging prohibited - BMS ne discharge rok di (ID814)

meaning.en: The BMS has blocked battery discharge. Normal if the battery is almost empty; otherwise the pack or its BMS needs checking.
meaning.ur: BMS ne battery discharge block kar diya. Agar battery khaali hone wali hai to normal hai; warna pack ya us ka BMS check karna hoga.

causes.en: Battery SOC at the lower cutoff - BMS stops discharge to protect the cells.
causes.ur: Battery SOC lower cutoff par hai - BMS cells bachane ke liye discharge rokta hai.

causes.en: Cell under-voltage: one or more cells in the pack dropped below its minimum.
causes.ur: Cell under-voltage: pack ka ek ya zyada cell apni minimum se neeche gir gaya.

causes.en: Pack imbalance or an aged pack with high internal resistance.
causes.ur: Pack imbalance ya aging pack jis ki internal resistance zyada ho gayi.

solutions.en: Read the SOC and battery voltage on the LCD; near-empty SOC with this message is expected.
solutions.ur: LCD par SOC aur battery voltage padhein; khaali hone wali SOC ke saath ye message aana expected hai.

solutions.en: If SOC is high and discharge is still blocked, measure pack voltage at the inverter BAT terminals with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC zyada hai phir bhi discharge blocked hai to multimeter se inverter BAT terminals par pack voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: A healthy pack with a blocked discharge points to a BMS or cell-balance problem - contact technical support.
solutions.ur: Theek pack ke saath discharge blocked hona BMS ya cell-balance ki ghalti batata hai - technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

title.ur: Battery radiator over temperature protection - battery band ho gayi (ID864)

meaning.en: The battery heat-sink over-temperature protection tripped - the battery is shut down, not just warning. Manual remedy: power off and wait 2 hours.
meaning.ur: Battery heat-sink ka over-temperature protection trip hua - battery band ho gayi, sirf warning nahi. Manual ka hal: power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein.

causes.en: Sustained high charge/discharge current in a hot environment with no cooling.
causes.ur: Garm mahol mein bina cooling ke mustaqbil high charge/discharge current.

causes.en: Battery cabinet air filter or vents blocked, so internal heat cannot escape.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ka air filter ya vents band, is liye andar ki heat nahi nikal rahi.

causes.en: Fan inside the battery cabinet failed or its connector is loose.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ka andar ka fan fail ya us ka connector loose.

solutions.en: Power the system off and wait 2 hours as the manual instructs, then re-check before restarting.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq system power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein, phir restart se pehle dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the battery cabinet vents and any air filter for dust blockage and clear them.
solutions.ur: Battery cabinet ke vents aur koi air filter dust se band ho to dekhein aur saaf karein.

solutions.en: Measure cabinet internal temperature with a thermometer; if it exceeds the limit even when cool outside, the fan or sensor has failed.
solutions.ur: Cabinet ka andar ka temperature thermometer se measure karein; agar bahar thandi ho ke bhi limit cross kare to fan ya sensor fail hai.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

aliases: Over temperature protection of ambient temperature

title.ur: Battery ambient over temperature protection - battery mahol garm hai (ID865)

meaning.en: The battery's ambient temperature protection tripped and the battery shut down. Manual remedy is the same: power off and wait 2 hours, then contact support if unresolved.
meaning.ur: Battery ka ambient temperature protection trip hua aur battery band ho gayi. Manual ka hal wohi hai: power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein, hal na ho to support se rabta karein.

causes.en: Ambient temperature in the battery room above the permitted range.
causes.ur: Battery room ka ambient temperature allowed range se upar.

causes.en: Battery installed in a sealed enclosure with no heat exchange.
causes.ur: Battery aise sealed enclosure mein hai jahan heat ka koi exchange nahi hota.

causes.en: Room temperature sensor inside the cabinet misreading low, so protection timing is wrong.
causes.ur: Cabinet ke andar ka room temperature sensor galat low reading de raha hai, jis se protection ka timing ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Power off and wait 2 hours, then measure the room temperature where the battery sits.
solutions.ur: Power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein, phir battery jahan lagi hai us kamre ka temperature measure karein.

solutions.en: Move the battery to a shaded, ventilated location and keep the manual's clearance from hot surfaces.
solutions.ur: Battery ko dhallee, ventilated jagah le jayein aur garam surfaces se manual ka faasla rakhein.

solutions.en: If the room is genuinely cool and it still trips, the internal temperature sensor needs replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar kamra sach mein thanda hai phir bhi trip ho to andar ka temperature sensor replace karna hoga.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

title.ur: Battery CAN1 communication failure - battery ka CAN link toota (ID867)

meaning.en: The battery's internal CAN1 link failed. Manual guidance: if it happens occasionally, wait a few minutes; if it happens frequently, contact support.
meaning.ur: Battery ka apna CAN1 link fail ho gaya. Manual ka mashwara: agar kabhi kabhi ho to kuch minute intezaar karein; agar baar baar ho to support se rabta karein.

causes.en: CAN cable loose at the battery or the inverter, or a poor contact at the connector.
causes.ur: Battery ya inverter par CAN cable loose, ya connector par poor contact.

causes.en: CAN bus not properly terminated, or two devices sharing a duplicate address.
causes.ur: CAN bus theek terminate nahi hua, ya do devices ka address duplicate hai.

causes.en: Battery CAN port damaged, or a battery-side controller fault.
causes.ur: Battery ka CAN port damaged, ya battery side controller ki ghalti.

solutions.en: Power off, reseat the CAN cable at both ends and confirm the connector latches fully closed.
solutions.ur: Power off karke CAN cable dono taraf se dobara baithayein aur confirm karein ke connector puri tarah band ho gaya.

solutions.en: Wait a few minutes and see whether the code clears, as the manual directs for occasional events.
solutions.ur: Kuch minute intezaar karke dekhein ke code clear hota hai ya nahi, jaise manual occasional events ke liye kehta hai.

solutions.en: If it recurs, verify unique CAN addresses and termination, then raise it with support since it is frequent.
solutions.ur: Agar dobara aaye to unique CAN address aur termination verify karein, phir support ko batayein kyunke ye frequent hai.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

title.ur: Battery bus software overvoltage - bus firmware ne overvoltage pakda (ID872)

meaning.en: The battery's internal bus firmware detected an overvoltage condition. Manual guidance: wait a few minutes for occasional events, contact support if frequent.
meaning.ur: Battery ke andar bus firmware ne overvoltage condition detect kiya. Manual ka mashwara: occasional event ho to kuch minute intezaar karein, frequent ho to support se rabta karein.

causes.en: Transient bus spike when a high charge current command was applied.
causes.ur: Zyada charge current command lagane par bus mein transient spike.

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing drift on the battery controller board.
causes.ur: Battery controller board par bus voltage sensing drift.

causes.en: Battery cell imbalance pushing part of the pack overvoltage.
causes.ur: Battery cell imbalance jis se pack ka hissa overvoltage par chala gaya.

solutions.en: Measure the battery pack voltage with a multimeter at the inverter BAT terminals and compare it to the LCD value.
solutions.ur: Inverter BAT terminals par multimeter se battery pack voltage measure karke LCD value se compare karein.

solutions.en: Wait a few minutes to see if the event was transient, exactly as the manual advises for occasional faults.
solutions.ur: Kabhi kabhi aane wale faults ke liye jaise manual kahe, kuch minute intezaar karke dekhein ke event transient tha ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the pack really is overvoltage, stop charging, let it settle and check the battery overvoltage setting against the battery spec.
solutions.ur: Agar pack sach mein overvoltage hai to charging band karein, use settle hone dein aur battery overvoltage setting battery spec se match karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

title.ur: Battery bus software undervoltage - bus firmware ne undervoltage pakda (ID873)

meaning.en: The battery's internal bus firmware detected an undervoltage condition on the battery bus.
meaning.ur: Battery ke bus firmware ne battery bus par undervoltage condition detect kiya.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged, or the DC isolator between battery and inverter left open.
causes.ur: Battery gehri tarah discharge ho gayi, ya battery aur inverter ke darmiyan DC isolator chhota hua.

causes.en: Battery cable voltage drop from a high-resistance or undersized connection.
causes.ur: Battery cable mein zyada resistance ya choti connection ki wajah se voltage drop.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery DC isolator is closed and fully seated before any other check.
solutions.ur: Doosri har check se pehle confirm karein ke battery DC isolator band aur poora baitha hai.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the inverter BAT terminals under load; a big drop across the cable means a bad connection.
solutions.ur: Load ke saath inverter BAT terminals par battery voltage measure karein; cable par bada drop matlab kharis connection.

solutions.en: Re-torque the battery lugs and inspect for corrosion, then let the battery recover before charging again.
solutions.ur: Battery lugs dobara tighten karke corrosion dekhein, phir dobara charge se pehle battery ko recover hone dein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

title.ur: Battery hardware overcurrent - pack ka andar ka asli overcurrent (ID879)

meaning.en: The battery's own hardware overcurrent comparator tripped - a real overcurrent inside the pack, not a software protection.
meaning.ur: Battery ka apna hardware overcurrent comparator trip hua - pack ke andar asal overcurrent, software protection nahi.

causes.en: Internal cell short in the pack, or an over-discharge event that damaged cells.
causes.ur: Pack mein internal cell short, ya itna zyada over-discharge ke cells kharab ho gaye.

causes.en: External short on the battery cable or a flooded connector.
causes.ur: Battery cable par external short ya geela connector.

causes.en: Discharge current exceeded the pack's continuous limit for its temperature.
causes.ur: Discharge current pack ki us temperature par defined continuous limit se zyada ho gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off, isolate the battery and check for a short with a multimeter before anything else.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karke battery isolate karein aur sab se pehle multimeter se short check karein.

solutions.en: Inspect every battery connector and cable for damage, water ingress or a crushed section, and replace what is faulty.
solutions.ur: Har battery connector aur cable ko damage, paani ya marasi ke liye dekhein aur kharis hissa replace karein.

solutions.en: If the pack is shorted internally, stop using it and have the module replaced - a hardware OCP is not a software-reset fault.
solutions.ur: Agar pack andar se short hai to use band karein aur module replace karwayein - hardware OCP software reset se hal nahi hota.
